# [STORY] As a maintainer, I want epic #15 and everything under it audited, so that "Core Microservices" is accurate and test-backed

## User Story
**As a** maintainer
**I want** epic #15 and every story and task under it audited
**So that** "Core Microservices" describes what was actually built, and every criterion is backed by a test or a re-runnable command

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given epic #15, when audited in epic mode, then it matches the epic
      template, meets the writing standard, and its native sub-issue links are
      complete and correct (audited; `audit-check.py 15`)
- [x] Given story #85 and its 3 tasks, when its audit task below is done, then every one of them has been through the four gates (#257)
- [x] Given story #86 and its 2 tasks, when its audit task below is done, then every one of them has been through the four gates (#258)
- [x] Given every criterion in this subtree, when it is read, then it names a
      test, a CI step, or a re-runnable command, and none closes on a date
      (`audit-check.py 15 --tree` reports none)
- [x] Given every issue in this subtree, when its metadata is read, then it has
      one type label, one priority label, no `sprint-N` label, and a correct
      native parent link (`audit-check.py 15 --tree`)
- [x] Given every child story is audited, when epic #15 is checked, then it
      is closed if all its stories are closed, and left open otherwise

## Definition of Ready
- [x] Meets [Definition of Ready](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_READY.md)

## Story Points
**Estimate:** 5

## Definition of Done
- [x] Meets [Definition of Done](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md)

## Notes
Scope: epic #15, its 2 stories, and the 5 tasks under them.

Method is `/audit-artifacts`: epic mode for the epic body, story mode for each
child story. One audit task per story under review.

Four tests were written where a criterion had none: `OpenApiDocsTest` in
movie-service, user-service and actor-service, and
`DateUtilsTest.hoursBetween_shouldCountRealElapsedHoursAcrossDaylightSaving`.
Epic #15 was already closed with both stories closed, so no state change was
needed there.
